privacy.canary_verification: Automated synthetic canary string must have 0 occurrences in logs, bugreports, SQLite WAL, daemon payloads, or Neo4j
privacy.speech_capture: User-initiated foreground service with visible system indicator only; zero raw audio bytes written to disk; RAM ring buffer only

security.sqlite_triggers: Strictly abort UPDATE and DELETE operations on append-only tables

epistemic_ledger.integrity: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining: hash = sha256(prev_hash + seq + ts + stream + kind + payload)
epistemic_ledger.immutability: BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers RAISE(ABORT)

active_inference_predictive_engine.framework: Discrete Learned Generative Model (Karl Friston Active Inference)

matrices.A: Observation likelihood P(o|s) Dirichlet count table
matrices.B: Transition model P(s'|s,a) Dirichlet count table
matrices.C: Prior preference distribution P(o) (negative surprisal for preferred states)

active_inference_predictive_engine.objective: Minimization of Expected Free Energy G(pi) = Epistemic Value (information gain) + Pragmatic Value (preference realization)
active_inference_predictive_engine.learning: Single-step conjugate Dirichlet updates (alpha <- alpha + 1) with bounded exponential decay forgetting
active_inference_predictive_engine.calibration: Pre-registered baseline comparison against 14-day trailing daypart usage

hot_cognitive_salience.dynamics: Continuous exponential energy decay: w = w0 * exp(-lambda * delta_t); spreading activation across weighted edges

associative_retrieval.fts: SQLite FTS5 Porter stemmer + unicode61 tokenizer
associative_retrieval.vectors: Int8 quantized nomic-embed-text (768 dimensions + 4-byte scale factor = 772 bytes/chunk)
associative_retrieval.index: In-memory contiguous Int8 buffer with brute-force SIMD cosine search

shadow_evaluation.precision_at_surface: Ratio of accepted proposals with Wilson 95% confidence interval lower bound >= 0.90
shadow_evaluation.circuit_breaker: Automatic HTTP 423 lock on actuation if rolling 14-day precision < 0.90

active_telemetry.source: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra -> pieces-android proxy :8787 -> exocortexd :8788

gates.G1_Integrity: Tamper rejection & valid file acceptance (4/4 rejected, 1/1 accepted)
gates.G3b_Leak: Retained PSS after release <= baseline + 100 MB
gates.G5_Stability: 0 crashes, 0 ANRs, 0 LMKD kills over 200 runs

components: ModelProvisioner (sideload staging, SHA-256 verify, atomic chmod)
TypedTextSummaryQueue (bounded capacity 4, immediate raw text zeroing)

milestone_3_speech_summaries.spec: Foreground mic service, streaming recognizer (evaluating sherpa-onnx vs whisper.cpp), RAM ring buffer only, encrypted speech_session table with biometric KEK

graph_store_transition.goal: Decommission external Neo4j JVM; deploy embedded in-process packages/graph-store
graph_store_transition.primary_candidate: LadybugDB / Kuzu C++ core via Node-API native bindings
graph_store_transition.fallback_candidate: SQLite edge tables inside primary exocortex.db (same-transaction projection)
graph_store_transition.concurrency_policy: exocortexd daemon is sole RW owner; CLI and tools query via HTTP :8788

counterfactual_error_mining.pipeline: Ledger -> Outbox Tailer -> Read-Only Graph Query -> Error Cluster Detection -> Proposal Event -> Active Inference Learner
counterfactual_error_mining.target_query: MATCH (p:Prediction)-[:IN_CONTEXT]->(c:Context) WHERE p.conf_cal >= tau AND p.resid_z >= z AND p.delta_vs_baseline > 0 RETURN c, count(*), avg(p.surprisal)

tables.name: devices
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE devices (device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('android','windows','linux')), pubkey_spki BLOB NOT NULL, key_attested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, scopes TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scopes)), enrolled_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked_at INTEGER) STRICT;

tables.name: events
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, device_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(device_id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, ts_device INTEGER NOT NULL, ts_server INTEGER NOT NULL, schema_ver INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload)), prev_hash BLOB NOT NULL, hash BLOB NOT NULL) STRICT;
indexes: CREATE INDEX events_kind_ts ON events(kind, ts_server);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_prev_hash ON events(prev_hash);
CREATE INDEX events_device_seq ON events(device_id, seq);
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'events table is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'events table is append-only'); END;

tables.name: invariants
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE invariants (invariant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, expression TEXT NOT NULL, level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (level IN ('soft','hard')), enqueued_at INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1) STRICT;

tables.name: model_params
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE model_params (param_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, matrix TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (matrix IN ('A','B','C','D')), row_idx INTEGER NOT NULL, col_idx INTEGER NOT NULL, alpha REAL NOT NULL CHECK (alpha > 0), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE (matrix, row_idx, col_idx)) STRICT;

tables.name: belief_snapshots
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE belief_snapshots (snap_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ts INTEGER NOT NULL, posterior_s BLOB NOT NULL, free_energy REAL NOT NULL, surprisal REAL NOT NULL) STRICT;

tables.name: proposals
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE proposals (proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, seq INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(seq), kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','rejected','executed','rolled_back')), efe_score REAL NOT NULL, pragmatic_val REAL NOT NULL, epistemic_val REAL NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload)), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, decided_at INTEGER) STRICT;

tables.name: gate_decisions
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE gate_decisions (decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES proposals(proposal_id), allowed INTEGER NOT NULL, shadow_mode INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, evaluated_at INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;

tables.name: shadow_labels
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE shadow_labels (label_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES proposals(proposal_id), user_action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (user_action IN ('executed_manually','ignored','contradicted')), latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;

tables.name: mutations
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE mutations (mutation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, branch TEXT NOT NULL, commit_hash TEXT NOT NULL, diff_stat TEXT NOT NULL, test_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (test_status IN ('passed','failed','aborted')), applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL, rolled_back_at INTEGER) STRICT;

tables.name: items
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE items (item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('memory','document','photo','video','audio','text','other')), title TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', mime TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ts INTEGER NOT NULL, blob_id TEXT, meta TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(meta)), tier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'archived' CHECK (tier IN ('hot','archived')), ingested_at INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;

tables.name: chunks
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE chunks (chunk_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(item_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ord INTEGER NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (item_id, ord)) STRICT;

tables.name: chunks_fts
tables.ddl: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunks_fts USING fts5(text, content='chunks', content_rowid='chunk_id', tokenize='porter unicode61');

tables.name: vectors
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE vectors (chunk_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES chunks(chunk_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, model TEXT NOT NULL, dim INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (dim > 0), scale REAL NOT NULL, q8 BLOB NOT NULL) STRICT;

tables.name: ingest_log
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE ingest_log (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ts INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, prev_hash TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT;
